parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace. This parameter is required by the backend and is used to isolate silence policy resources across different business workspaces
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。后端要求必填，用于隔离不同业务空间的静默策略资源
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the silence policy. If you do not specify this parameter when creating a silence policy, the system generates the ID. You can query the ID by calling the ListMaintainWindows operation
parameters.help_zh: 静默策略 ID。创建静默策略时若未指定则由系统生成，可通过 ListMaintainWindows 查询
parameters.name: maintain_window_id

maintainWindowId.description_en: The ID of the enabled silence policy
maintainWindowId.description_zh: 已启用的静默策略 ID

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, which is used for troubleshooting and ticket tracking
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一 ID，用于问题排查与工单定位
